content.json:
# TasteMatcher Production
Privacy-safe product activity plus API and Function observability. Data is retained for 30 days with a 0.25 GB/day ingestion cap. Product panels contain event types, counts, roles, sources, and statuses only—never emails, names, titles, comments, or record IDs.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'tastematcher-prd-api-ca' and TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| extend activity = parse_json(extract(@'(\{.*\})', 1, Log_s))
| where tostring(activity.event) == 'product_activity'
| extend eventName = tostring(activity.eventName), eventCount = tolong(activity.count)
| summarize Events = count(), Total = sum(coalesce(eventCount, 1)) by eventName
| order by Total desc

ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'tastematcher-prd-api-ca' and TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| extend activity = parse_json(extract(@'(\{.*\})', 1, Log_s))
| where tostring(activity.event) == 'product_activity'
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), eventName = tostring(activity.eventName)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'tastematcher-prd-api-ca' and TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| extend activity = parse_json(extract(@'(\{.*\})', 1, Log_s))
| where tostring(activity.event) == 'product_activity' and tostring(activity.eventName) in ('proposal.created', 'proposal.status_changed', 'proposal.comment_added')
| project TimeGenerated, eventName = tostring(activity.eventName), previousStatus = tostring(activity.previousProposalStatus), status = tostring(activity.proposalStatus), actorRole = tostring(activity.actorRole)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'tastematcher-prd-api-ca' and TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| extend activity = parse_json(extract(@'(\{.*\})', 1, Log_s))
| where tostring(activity.event) == 'product_activity' and tostring(activity.eventName) in ('artwork.created', 'auction.import_completed')
| project TimeGenerated, eventName = tostring(activity.eventName), source = tostring(activity.source), provider = tostring(activity.provider), created = tolong(activity.count), skipped = tolong(activity.skippedCount), failed = tolong(activity.failedCount)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'tastematcher-prd-api-ca' and TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| extend activity = parse_json(extract(@'(\{.*\})', 1, Log_s))
| where tostring(activity.event) == 'product_activity'
| project TimeGenerated, eventName = tostring(activity.eventName), actorRole = tostring(activity.actorRole), source = tostring(activity.source), provider = tostring(activity.provider), count = tolong(activity.count)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100

ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'tastematcher-prd-api-ca'
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| project TimeGenerated, Log_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100

ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'tastematcher-prd-api-ca'
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Log_s has_any ('error', 'exception', 'fatal')
| project TimeGenerated, Log_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100

AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| project TimeGenerated, SeverityLevel, Message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100

Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize IngestedGB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1024, 4) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), DataType
| order by TimeGenerated asc
